scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names bend,frend "npm run dev --workspace bend" "npm run dev --workspace frend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace bend && npm run build --workspace frend
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names bend,frend "npm run start --workspace bend" "npm run start --workspace frend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces
